summary: Hydro One Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, including financial statements, MD&A, and CEO/CFO certifications. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or other corporate action is described. The filing is a standard financial update with no deal terms, strategic changes, or unusual corporate activity.
